name: Insel Camping
beschreibung: The campsite Insel Camping is located in Waltenhofen in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The site lies in quiet, close-to-nature surroundings. The surrounding area is characterized by the mountain landscape of the Alpen and offers access to an extensive hiking trail network. In winter, several ski areas are available in the region. The site's facilities include sanitary facilities, pitches for various vehicle types, and a bread roll service. Guests use the site as a base for activities in the surrounding mountains and valleys.
